## TileVisNode

```java
public abstract class TileVisNode extends BlockEntity
```

Original TileVisNode's first/40-tick graph phase, with native identity, lifecycle and consume-frame fences. Links are weak, transient and reciprocal.

Raw source hook: debit before return, without notification callbacks. Alleging isSource=true without a real debit is an error, not a producer.

<a id="tilevisnode-availablefromsource"></a>
```java

```

Read-only availability of the source for an aspect; the default source holds none. A source that can debit has to report the same amount here, so that a dry run of a drain answers exactly what the real drain would take.

## VisNetHandler

```java
public final class VisNetHandler
```

Original root-biased attachment and one-nearest-node-per-root consumption. Raw network amounts are NOT multiplied by100. No graph selection uses RNG. All persistent static references to worlds/nodes are weak; root lifecycle hooks still explicitly clear the complete level/server lifetime.

```java
public static void requireAmuletGrant(thaumcraft.common.tiles.TileVisRelay relay, Aspect aspect, int units)
```

<a id="visnethandler-requireworkbenchgrant"></a>
```java

```

Closed native receive frame: no public callback can forge or replay a paid workbench-wand credit.

<a id="visnethandler-isnativeserverlevel"></a>
```java
public static boolean isNativeServerLevel(Level level)
```

No overridable Level callback runs without a recursion fence. A subclass borrowing a real server is not that server's actual installed world. Null/client/non-server levels return false; server levels without an owner or called off-thread throw IllegalStateException.

<a id="visnethandler-drainvis-2"></a>
```java
public static int drainVis(Level level, BlockPos pos, int amount, boolean simulate)
```

The aspect-less drain of the legacy 1.12 add-on surface.

The retained 1.12 reference drained the VIS NETWORK at the position and not the essence of a single node: `src/main/java/thaumcraft/common/world/aura/AuraHandler.java:27-33` delegates to `VisNetHandler.drainVis(world, x, y, z, requested, simulate)`, and that method walks the primal aspects of every root source that is in range of the position (`src/main/java/thaumcraft/api/visnet/VisNetHandler.java:92-139`). The native network has one aspect per call, so the aspect-less form is the loop over the primal aspects, in the original order of `Aspect.getPrimalAspects()`.

Forced 1.21.1 change: the amount is an integer, the original surface used a float.

<a id="visnethandler-planprimaldrain"></a>
```java
public static int planPrimalDrain(int amount, java.util.function.ToIntFunction<Aspect> available)
```

The original aspect-less drain plan.

Retained 1.12 reference `src/main/java/thaumcraft/api/visnet/VisNetHandler.java:92-139`: every primal aspect is taken in the order of `Aspect.getPrimalAspects()`, each of them bounded by what is still requested.
